stem.en: Which part of a tsunami early warning system is about training people, and not about instruments?

feedback.en: Yes. It means training officials and coastal communities to understand and act on warnings.
This uses computers to work out how a tsunami may travel.
This is an instrument station that measures sea level.
This is equipment that carries information.

explanation.en: Capacity development means training officials and coastal communities, so that they understand warnings and know how to respond. The other three are instruments or computer work.

hints.en: Look for the part that is about people rather than machines.
